answer: Any identity can be challenged. A challenger posts 0.05 POA; the accused must answer with evidence backed by a jade bond within 7 epochs or forfeit its 0.10 POA bond to the challenger. Three independent attestors meet at one vertex: if two agree the identity is fake, its bond burns and its vouching tree is pruned. A fake identity is dead timber, and one honest cut fells the whole branch. 100 sybils cost 10 POA in bonds for 0.5 POA each before the first dispute lands. Edge case: rivals could spam disputes; mitigation burns the challenger's 0.05 POA on every failed dispute, so harassment loses.
